B.928

Director of Criminal Intelligence,

Sir,

With reference to your letter No. 981/1925
dated 8th December re the Thompson Auto Rifle,
I beg to inform you that the above weapon has duly
been delivered ex s.s. "President Pearce".

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

for Commissioner of Police.

C.I.D. Headquarter Staff Station:
December 12, 1925

REPORT ON Theft of Thompson Gun from S/S President Jackson.

Made by C.D.I. Eek Forwarded by

Sir,

The Thompson Gun was found in Hongkong and was returned
here by S/S President Pierce to Mr. Hoover. How and where
the gun was recovered is not yet known.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔此处转录不清〕
C. D. I.

D. C. I.

P.S. Found among the Hongkong Mail.

〔此处转录不清〕

1925年12月12日

关于从“杰克逊总统”号轮船上盗窃汤普森枪的报告。

由刑事侦缉督察 Eek 撰写 转呈者

先生，

汤普森枪在香港被发现，并由“皮尔斯总统”号轮船运回此处交给胡佛（Hoover）先生。目前尚不清楚该枪是如何以及在何处被找回的。

此致
敬礼
〔此处转录不清〕
刑事侦缉督察 (C. D. I.)

December 1, 1925.

REPORT ON Theft from S/S President Jackson.

Made by C.D.I. Eek. Forwarded by ____

Sir,

Mr. Hoover agent for the Thompson gun reports that on
the arrival here of the S/S President Jackson Saturday November
28th 1925 a Thompson Auto-rifle a new patent sent here and
addressed to him was found missing from the Mail Room of the
above ship. Members of the crew are suspected, and as an
attempt might be made to land it in Hongkong, he suggest that
attached telegram, for which he is willing to pay, be sent.
The Chief Officer of the ship has all particulars. Mr.
Hoover has already wired Manila.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔签名〕
C. D. I.

D. C. I.

〔手写批注：〕
Gw B
1 p 1/c Haynes

returns please call and ascertain if
there are any further news of the
missing rifle 3/12 25.
〔签名〕

1925年12月1日。

关于从“杰克逊总统”号轮船上盗窃案的报告。

由刑事侦缉督察 Eek 撰写。转呈者 ____

先生，

汤普森枪代理商胡佛（Hoover）先生报告称，当“杰克逊总统”号轮船于1925年11月28日星期六抵达此处时，发现寄给他的一支新型专利汤普森自动步枪从该船的邮件室失踪。船员受到怀疑，鉴于有人可能试图在香港将其卸上岸，他建议发送所附电报，费用他愿意承担。该船大副掌握所有详细情况。胡佛先生已致电马尼拉。

此致
敬礼
〔签名〕
刑事侦缉督察 (C. D. I.)

副刑事侦缉处长 (D. C. I.)

〔手写批注：〕
Gw B
1 p 1/c Haynes
当“杰克逊总统”号返回时，请联系并查明是否有关于失踪步枪的进一步消息 1925年12月3日。
〔签名〕

The Company may decline to forward any Telegram although it has been received for transmission, but in that case the Company shall, on request, refund the amount paid for the transmission and delivery of such Telegram.
If any Telegram shall fail to reach its destination by reason of any neglect or default of the Company or its Servants, which shall have happened whilst the same remained under the control of the Company, and such failure shall not have been caused by "force majeure," or by other circumstances which the Company could not have controlled, then the Company will refund to the Sender of such Telegram the amount paid for its transmission and delivery, less all moneys paid or payable by the Company in respect of such transmission or delivery to any other administration or authority (whether telegraphic or otherwise and whether working in connection with or not), which shall not be exclusively controlled by the Company.
The Company shall not be liable to refund any part of the amount paid for the transmission or delivery of a Telegram in any case in which the non-delivery thereof has been caused by "force majeure," or by other circumstances which the Company could not have controlled, whether there shall be error or default on the part of the Company or its Servants while the Telegram was under its control.
The Company shall not, nor shall any other telegraphic administration or authority, be liable in any case whatever to make any compensation amount (if any) to be refunded as above mentioned, for any loss, injury, or damage arising or resulting from the non-transmission or non-delivery delay, error, or omission in the transmission or delivery thereof, from whatever cause such non-transmission, non-delivery, delay, error, or omission.
For the purposes of these conditions the control of the Company over each telegram shall be deemed to have entirely ceased when, in the case the Telegram to its destination, it shall have been entrusted by the Company for further transmission by telegraph or by post or otherwise to an not exclusively controlled by the Company, and in case of further transmission by any line, system, or service of telegraphs, whether the same part of, or in connection with, the telegraphic system or service of the Company, and the Company shall have full power to entrust any Telegram any other administration or authority subject to any conditions prescribed by them.

I request that the above Telegram may be forwarded according to the rules of the International Telegraph Convention, and according to the Company's conditions printed above, by which I agree to abide.
